crossRefs.note: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.
You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened…
in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not…
I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.
Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he…
I clothed you also with embroidered work, and put sealskin sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered…
They will also strip you of your clothes, and take away your beautiful jewels.
They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness…
Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes…
Lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her…
Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax…

translations.web: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes, and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.
translations.bsb: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will level your mounds and tear down your lofty shrines. They will strip off your clothes, take your fine jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
translations.kjv: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
translations.asv: I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thy vaulted place, and break down thy lofty places; and they shall strip thee of thy clothes, and take thy fair jewels; and they shall leave thee naked and bare.
